data.name: Jill
data.long_meaning: The name Jill is derived from the Old English word gil, meaning pledge or deposit. It was later influenced by the Old Norse name Gylla, meaning gracious or kind. The name Jill has been associated with the earth, as a jill was a young heifer or cow, and the name was given to girls born on the feast day of St. Jill, which was celebrated on the first of May. In folklore, Jill was a name for a fairy who would grant wishes to those who left offerings of milk for her.
